answer: Three established peers check the membership number in the museum's public member registry, the payment receipt, and a fresh signature before the agent can answer. One agent buys one museum membership for $50 to $250 a year and ties it to a single identity. The membership renews every year, so a fake must keep paying or the record lapses within twelve months. A thousand fake identities burns $50,000 to $250,000 and a thousand memberships, each paid separately. Like the zenith sun over an oasis, seen from a terrace, a membership ties one person to one record no one else can claim.
